recipe.positive: Visual style (follow exactly): in the style of Hergé's ligne claire style (The Adventures of Tintin). Warm European clear-line comic illustration. Use clean contours of uniform weight, simple readable forms and flat colour fills. Characters look approachable and expressive; interiors and everyday props feel cosy. Keep panel and scene hierarchy easy to follow, with gentle warm light and restrained nostalgic colours.
